approval: Owner 10/30 (#133 6512706287 §D, decision recorded in 6512756252 header); scope fixed by GPT 6513028156 §1.5 / 6537701769 §4.4
effective_from: set when the Owner approves switching the production scorecard; until then fsc-1.0 stays the official scorecard
purpose: Same rules as fsc-1.0 except QQQ and QQQM are excluded from hit/miss. Derived from the fsc-1.0 outcome rows (no new outcome rows, no rescoring, fsc-1.0 history unchanged); reported side by side.

rules.primary_metric: excess_vs_qqq = (close_h / close_0 - 1) - (QQQ_h / QQQ_0 - 1), closes taken only from the ledgers' own rows
rules.unmapped_decision: unscored_unmapped (counted, never a hit or miss)
rules.missing_close: unavailable (counted separately, never scored, never filled)
rules.below_min_n: report 'insufficient_sample' with n; no hit rate, no interval
rules.independence_view: also report independent episodes: only the first row of each run of consecutive sessions with the same (symbol, decision) counts
descriptive_only: max adverse excursion over the window from the ledger's daily closes
rules.benchmark_identical_policy: matured rows of these symbols are counted as 'benchmark_identical': never hit, never miss, never in a rate (their excess vs the QQQ benchmark is 0 or tracking error by construction)
